info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Human Resource Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Employee Access Update API facilitates the modification of employee access settings within the human resource management system. It allows authorized users to make incremental updates to the access parameters associated with individual employees using a specific reference parameter. This API is essential for HR professionals and system administrators who need to efficiently manage employee access rights. Use cases include adjusting permissions based on role changes and ensuring compliance with company policies.

patch.description: This operation allows you to modify the access details for a specific employee in the human resource management system. Use this endpoint to update attributes such as access level, permissions, and other relevant information for the designated employee.

requestBody.description: Request body for updating the employee access details in the Human Resource Management system. This body should include the necessary fields to modify the access information of the employee identified by EMP-900045.
